projects.name: ChronoDB
projects.summary: A relational database engine with Git semantics: commit, branch, merge and time-travel your data.

bullets: Built a **Git-style relational database engine from scratch** with immutable commits, copy-on-write branching, time-travel queries and **conflict-aware three-way merge** over a commit DAG.
Wrote the storage layer (**LRU buffer pool**, **B+ Tree** indexes, **WAL with ARIES-style redo recovery**, mark-and-sweep GC), backed by **126 unit tests** and benchmarked against **SQLite**.

projects.name: RaftKV
projects.summary: Leader election, log replication and snapshots, checked for linearizability under network partitions.

bullets: Implemented the **Raft consensus protocol from scratch in Go** (leader election, log replication, persistence, snapshot compaction) behind a gRPC key-value API with **linearizable** reads and writes.

Built a **chaos harness** that injects network partitions, node crashes and message loss; verified **500** randomized fault-injection runs with the **Porcupine linearizability checker** and sustained **8,000 ops/s** at **p99 commit latency under 15 ms** on a 5-node cluster.

projects.name: PGARA
projects.summary: A compiler for a C subset whose register allocator learns which paths are hot from a profiling run, then spends registers where they save the most cycles.

metrics.label: spill memory traffic vs linear scan
benchmark runs verified against the interpreter

bullets: Built, in a team of 5, a full compiler for a C subset: DFA lexer, **LL(1) recursive-descent parser**, semantic analysis, **pruned SSA**, an SCCP/GVN/DCE optimiser and a cycle-counting RISC simulator; I owned the lexer, parser, AST and IR generation.

Its **profile-guided register allocator** (per-value MDPs solved by policy iteration, sealed-bid auctions on the chordal interference graph) cut cycles by **20.4%** and spill memory traffic by **80%** vs linear scan across 50 benchmark runs; written up as an **IEEE-format paper**.

projects.name: TinyInfer
projects.summary: KV cache, paged attention, continuous batching and int8 quantisation, benchmarked against Hugging Face.

metrics.label: target throughput vs Hugging Face generate()
target GPU memory with int8 weights

bullets: Built a transformer inference server with a **KV cache**, **paged attention** and **continuous batching**, streaming tokens from **TinyLlama-1.1B** on a single T4 GPU.

Added **int8 weight quantisation** cutting GPU memory by **47%**; reached **3.2x** the throughput of a Hugging Face generate() baseline at 16 concurrent requests, with **p99 time-to-first-token of 210 ms**.

projects.name: StreamGuard
projects.summary: Streaming features, low-latency model serving, drift monitoring and shadow deploys.

bullets: Streamed transactions through **Kafka** into a **Redis feature store** and scored them with a **LightGBM** model on **ONNX Runtime** at **2,000 events/s** with **14 ms p99 latency**.
Versioned models in **MLflow** with shadow deployments and **PSI-based drift alerts**; reached **0.84 PR-AUC** on the Kaggle credit-card fraud dataset (0.17% positive class).

projects.name: QueueForge
projects.summary: A job queue built on Redis primitives that survives crashed workers and flaky jobs.

bullets: Designed a distributed job queue on **Redis sorted sets, hashes and Pub/Sub** with priority scheduling, delayed execution and PostgreSQL as the durable source of truth.

Added heartbeats, a **reaper that re-queues jobs from crashed workers**, backoff retries and a dead-letter queue; in a 500-job load test with **30% injected failures**, **99.2%** completed at **410 jobs/s** ingest.

projects.name: TravelCraft
projects.summary: Trip planning solved as a routing problem: which places, which day, what order, inside opening hours.

bullets: Modelled trip planning as a **Team Orienteering Problem with Time Windows** and built an **Iterated Local Search** solver (greedy insertion, 2-opt/Or-opt, inter-day relocate and swap).
Across 405 benchmark trips, cut daily **travel time by 45%** and eliminated the opening-hour conflicts that broke **37%** of the old planner's days, at **p95 solve time under 25 ms**.

projects.name: CodeAtlas AI
projects.summary: Ask a repository questions in plain English and get answers grounded in the code, with citations.

bullets: Built **hybrid retrieval** fusing pgvector cosine search and Postgres full-text search via **Reciprocal Rank Fusion**, with 1-hop import-graph expansion over tree-sitter code chunks.
Reached a **93.3% top-15 retrieval hit rate** on hand-annotated queries at **312 ms** average latency; streamed answers over SSE with inline file citations.

projects.name: ResearchMate
projects.summary: Six cooperating agents that search the literature, read the PDFs and write up the research gaps.

metrics.label: agent nodes in a LangGraph state machine

bullets: Orchestrated a **6-node LangGraph agent pipeline** that searches OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar, parses full-text PDFs, extracts structured findings and synthesizes citation-backed research gaps.
Stripped bibliographies during PDF parsing to cut **LLM token usage by up to 40%**; shipped with Docker Compose and GitHub Actions CI.

projects.name: Die-Yield Failure Prediction
projects.summary: Predicting which passing dies on a wafer will fail final test, and explaining why.

bullets: Predicted latent die failures on a **highly imbalanced (4.2% positive)** wafer dataset by gradient boosting over 549 parametric, KD-tree spatial and PCA-compressed features with wafer-grouped CV.
Lifted **AUC-PR by 7.8%** and **recall by 8.8%** over the baseline model, confirmed by a 2,000-resample wafer-level bootstrap; explained predictions with per-die occlusion attribution.
